design: Two separate fresh subprocesses, sequential, fixed prompt/seed/settings; no retries or selection.

messages.content: Return only a JSON array containing exactly 4 arrays. Each inner array must contain exactly 4 distinct single lowercase English words that are synonyms of each other. No word may appear in more than one array. Use only letters a-z inside each word. Do not include explanations, Markdown, numbers, or additional text.
